headline: A 2001 executive order about making sure workers are told their rights regarding paying union dues or fees.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with telling employees about their rights when it comes to paying union dues or fees. It focuses on notifying workers, such as through posted notices, rather than changing how much dues cost. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, such as which employers must give notice and how, are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Workers in jobs covered by union contracts
who_it_affects.how: They would be informed of their rights about paying union dues or fees.
They may have to give workers notice of these rights.
Workers they represent would get information about their rights on dues and fees.
